name.full: Black History Month 2026 Hub: Honouring Our Communities

description.short: Black history, heritage and inclusion for the UK public sector.
description.full: A shared hub for departments, agencies, the NHS, local government, policing, justice and schools: the Black History Month 2026 theme, history and heritage, Africa and the diaspora, language guidance, a ready-to-run toolkit, posters, leadership actions and the evidence behind them. Every fact links to its source. Content only: the hub collects no personal data when used in Teams; anything you save stays in your own browser.
